name: io.github.example-org/trellis
title: Trellis
description: Call 350+ AI models with signed receipts, or keep a prompt on attested TEE providers only. Pay with prepaid USDC credits on Solana, per call with x402 (exact), or from an open tab.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Trellis API key (sk-tr-v1-...)>. Only the chat tool needs it; the model lists, verify_provider and the receipt tools answer without one.

headers.name: X-Trellis-Lane
headers.description: Optional. Set to attested to send every chat call only to providers whose enclave the router verified (it refuses rather than falls back).

headers.name: X-PAYMENT
headers.description: Optional, instead of a key: an x402 exact payment on Solana for this call (base64 JSON {x402Version: 1, scheme: "exact", network, payload: {transaction}}, the payer-signed USDC TransferChecked with the facilitator as fee payer) from the 402 reply's accepts entry.

headers.name: X-Trellis-Tab
headers.description: Optional, instead of a key: the base58 address of an open trellis_tab Tab whose payee is this router (the tab x402 scheme).

headers.name: X-Trellis-Tab-Voucher
headers.description: With X-Trellis-Tab: base64(tab || cumulative_used u64 LE || seq u64 LE) + '.' + base64(ed25519 signature by the tab's session key), covering everything served so far.

x402.note: The 402 reply of the chat tool's upstream call quotes the exact amount; payTo, feePayer and program are filled in at deploy time from GET /facilitator/supported.
